blocks.content: The kanji **中** attaches to nouns with two different readings and two different meanings. The verb or context usually makes the reading clear.

left.label: 〜中 (ちゅう)
left.description: Currently in that activity or state : happening right now.
left.example_en: I'm in a meeting right now.

right.label: 〜中 (じゅう)
right.description: Spanning the whole thing : throughout all of a time or space.
right.example_en: I've been working all day long.

rows.japanese: すみません、今、電話中です。
rows.english: Sorry, I'm on the phone right now.

rows.japanese: 使用中のため入れません。
世界中の人が知っています。
rows.romaji: Sekai jū no hito ga shitte imasu.
rows.english: People all over the world know about it.

rows.japanese: 日本中を旅行しました。

blocks.content: ちゅう = the activity is in progress right now (a slice of time). じゅう = no part is excluded (the full extent of a time or space). 勉強中 = studying at this moment. 一日中勉強した = studied without stopping for the entire day.
